author: Milwaukee WI Daily Brief
title: 🚚 Milwaukee supply chain roles with multiple $90K+ opportunities
text:
1 days ago Milwaukee’s logistics scene is busy right now, from hands-on planning roles to big-picture leadership and consulting. If you’re into supply chain, there’s a mix of local HQ gigs and national players hiring.
Supply Chain Intern (Summer 2027) Employer: Zurn Elkay Water Solutions
Location: Milwaukee, WI (HQ)
Type: Full-time summer internship
Salary: Not listed
Help the global procurement team with analytics, reporting, and cost-savings projects while learning quote analysis, project management, and supplier selection. Great fit for students in Supply Chain or Business who can work 40 hours/week in summer and want real exposure to a global supply chain.
CDC General Manager - Milwaukee Employer: Viking Electric (Sonepar company)
Location: Milwaukee, WI
Type: Full-time
Salary: $115,000 – $150,000 base + ~20% bonus + full benefits
Run a Central Distribution Center and lead managers across safety, service, inventory, and continuous improvement. Ideal for someone with 5+ years in operations/logistics and 3+ years people leadership , ready to own performance and grow future leaders.
Senior Manager, Supply Chain – National Brands Employer: Direct Supply
Location: Milwaukee, WI
Type: Full-time
Salary: Not listed (senior leadership role)
Own the strategy and performance for National Brands supply chain, leading a sourcing team and driving cost, service, and revenue growth . Best for pros with 7–10 years in supply chain/strategic sourcing , strong negotiation skills, and experience leading cross-functional initiatives.
Associate Supply Planner Employer: Uline
Location: Corporate HQ – Pleasant Prairie, WI (Milwaukee area)
Type: Full-time, on-site
Salary: Not listed
Use sales data to forecast demand , support new product launches, and partner with buyers to prevent stockouts. Great entry-level option if you have a Bachelor’s degree , like working with numbers, and want strong day-one benefits and bonuses at a stable, growing company.
Senior Buyer Employer: Bellwether Staffing Solutions (search firm for a manufacturer)
Location: Milwaukee, WI (North side, on-site)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $90,000 – $115,000 base + bonus + benefits (up to ~$125K for 12–15+ yrs exp)
Lead sourcing for manufacturing commodities like castings, metal fab, hydraulics, drivetrains, engines, or plastics , managing $30–$50M spend and supplier strategy. Good for local candidates with 5+ years manufacturing sourcing , strong negotiation chops, and willingness to travel 20–30% .
Kinaxis Architect - Supply Chain Consulting Sr. Manager Employer: PwC
Location: Milwaukee, WI (consulting/remote-hybrid per firm policy)
Type: Full-time
Salary: $124,000 – $280,000 + annual discretionary bonus + benefits
Lead design and implementation of Kinaxis solutions and large supply chain transformation projects for clients. A strong match if you have 6+ years experience , advanced skills in supply chain tech, and like guiding teams and advising clients at a strategic level.
